source:
@@U03342@@
What a tremor, what a rumble,
What a gruesome grating, grumble,
What a reeling, what a quaking!
This way first, then that way shaking!
But you'll not see us budge an inch,
However close the dreadful pinch,
Even though all Hell broke loose!
Now a mound out of the ground
Rises up with a dreadful sound.
We know him well, for who but he
Raised fair Delos from the sea,
Grizzled old codger, from ocean’s floor,
To give mother Leto a shore to bear
Bright 福玻斯 and his sister there.
Now thrusting, squeezing, straining, prying,
Arms stretched taut and shoulders plying,
阿特拉斯-like he lifts his shoulders,
Heaves up soil and massive boulders,
Sand and gravel, shale and clay,
Where once our tranquil river lay.
Across our peaceful valley floor
He cuts a gap and then no more.
For like a massive caryatid,
Waist-deep in the bare earth squatted,
He stops, unmoving, without a groan,
Bearing a monstrous weight of stone,
Nearer he will not approach,
Nor upon our haunt encroach.

@@U03344@@
All this is my doing, mine alone,
as the world will one day concede.
What would your earth have been without
the beauty my jostling and jolting gave it?
And your mountains,
soaring splendidly into the sky,
translation:
@@U03342@@
多么震动，多么隆隆，
多么可怕的刺耳声，抱怨声，
何等的摇摇欲坠，何等的颤抖！
先这边晃动，再那边晃动！
但你不会看到我们有一丝一毫的让步，
无论多么可怕的挤压，
尽管地狱全都崩溃了！
现在从地下冒出一个土堆
伴随着可怕的声音站了起来。
我们很了解他，除了他之外还有谁
从海上升起美丽的提洛岛，
头发花白的老家伙，来自海底，
给莱托妈妈一个可以依靠的岸
布莱特福玻斯和他的妹妹在那里。
现在推挤、挤压、用力、撬动，
手臂绷紧，肩膀转动，
阿特拉斯——就像他抬起肩膀，
举起泥土和巨石，
沙子和砾石、页岩和粘土，
我们平静的河流曾经所在的地方。
穿过我们宁静的谷底
他切开了一个缺口，然后就没有了。
因为就像一个巨大的女像柱，
蹲在齐腰深的光秃秃的土地上，
他停了下来，一动不动，没有一声呻吟，
承载着巨大的石头重量，
他不会再靠近，
也不侵犯我们的出没地。

@@U03344@@
这一切都是我做的，我一个人做的，
正如世界有一天会承认的那样。
如果没有你的地球将会怎样
我的推挤和颠簸给它带来了美丽吗？
还有你的山，
华丽地飞向天空，
